Static HTML preview sample

A document, not a slide.

This report flows vertically. It has no deck marker, slideshow runtime, or slide controls.

1. What this checks

Inline CSS, headings, lists, tables and long content should remain readable at the width of the preview panel. Scroll down inside the page to reach the end.

  • Resize the panel: paragraphs wrap rather than stretching a slide.
  • Choose Source to inspect the original document.
  • Return to Rendered to read the formatted page.

2. Preview modes

FileExpected behavior
Ordinary HTMLStatic page, vertical scrolling
HTML presentation16:9 slides and navigation
PowerPointBest-effort content preview

3. Isolation is deliberate

The preview does not run arbitrary scripts, navigate links, submit forms, or load external/local assets. A downloaded file has a different trust context.

This sample needs no network connection, fonts, JavaScript, or external stylesheet. Everything required for its static appearance is contained in this file.
